title: Sweeping the gyro filter down: less filtering is worse
question: Does the ring frequency track the gyro filter, making it a loop mode rather than a mechanical one?
headline: Unanswered — tau = 15 ms fell (peak 43 deg, 250 deg of drift) and the raw segment never ran. But tau = 30 with the friction compensation off is the calmest configuration yet: 2.24 deg RMS, +-7.3 deg peak.
